findings.statement: Exact-key normalization yields 16 raw findings and 16 unique (claim_id,evidence_fingerprint,verdict) keys: no finding is counted twice. The two C-F10-INDEPENDENT findings sharing fingerprint 438bfbc3 but carrying INCONCLUSIVE and FAIL are not a vote conflict: the former concerns T8 alone, while the latter is the full gate verdict after tail, state-retention, uncertainty, and provenance defects are added. Likewise, the C-F10-SCOPE PASS and FAIL findings address different predicates: the unchanged F-11/QKE/public-work scope gate passes, while anti-inflation/cost policy fails. Terminal adjudication is evidence- and gate-text-based, not majority-based.
assumptions_used: Finding granularity is determined by each precise statement and governing gate, not prose similarity alone.
A policy meta-finding misbound to C-F10-SCOPE does not silently redefine G-F10-SCOPE.
evidence_refs: all six declared sibling result envelopes
reproduction: Extract every findings[] tuple (claim_id,evidence_fingerprint,verdict) from the six declared sibling envelopes and count exact unique tuples.

findings.statement: G-HARNESS-INTEGRITY is FAIL. D-058 validly resolves the prior cross-run ACTIVE_RUN race on the successful-lease path, and its overlapping-run/tamper/replacement evidence remains a bounded PASS. It does not close the whole gate: a controlled negative demonstrated acceptance of a different same-runtime registered assignment because the Start lease seals every run assignment rather than one parent-admitted assignment, and Start catches a lease-write OSError then permits the exact mutable ACTIVE_RUN fallback invalidated by D-057. The strongest acceptance steelman is the real D-058 lease canary plus 12/12 fixtures and documented parent-side admission. The decisive rejection is fail-closed: neither self-selected intra-run assignment substitution nor mandatory-lease write failure may be admitted. The smallest remedy is an atomic parent-authenticated agent_id-to-one-assignment receipt, a hard Start failure when its write fails, two negative fixtures, and a replacement overlapping-main live canary.
assumptions_used: One spawned agent is authorized for exactly one parent-admitted assignment.
A mandatory lease-write failure must stop rather than silently restore mutable global authority.
Manual parent checking is defense in depth, not automatic Stop-side binding.
reproduction: Repeat the registered same-run cross-assignment controlled negative.
Inject a lease-write failure and verify that Start currently continues with ACTIVE_RUN fallback.

findings.statement: Current SSOT consistency is FAIL. FROZEN_DECISIONS D-064, CLAIM_REGISTRY, and GATE_REGISTRY record the scientific PASS flips, while SHARED_CONTEXT still declares the same gates FAIL and its immediate slice forbids the remediation and trajectory that D-060--D-063 record as completed. Hash-valid source aggregation cannot choose between contradictory current-state assertions. This provenance failure does not erase the bounded D-061/D-063 numerical evidence, but it prevents an unqualified all-gates-PASS handoff until a single-writer reconciliation records the present adjudicated states.
assumptions_used: All current Tier-0 context surfaces are jointly authoritative absent an explicit precedence rule.
reproduction: Compare SHARED_CONTEXT current-milestone/immediate-slice assertions with D-064 and the two PASS gate records.

findings.statement: C-F10-ROW9-CLOSURE is a bounded PASS on module bytes 760a7c04. Exact event accounting, reversal/sign equivalence, current-byte E1--E5 replay, asymmetric S3/CP checks, conservation, entropy, and the order-one single-chart falsifier support the six-member two-chart discretization repair. This validates only the specified orientation-closure construction; absolute V-A normalization, phase-space normalization, and physical catalogue completeness remain INCONCLUSIVE and are not promoted by this result.
assumptions_used: The frozen K_t/32 target-directed normalization is specified input rather than independently validated physics.
The simultaneous incoming/outgoing leg-exchange quotient preserves the frozen kernel and signed weak action.
unresolved: Absolute physical normalization and catalogue completeness remain INCONCLUSIVE.

findings.statement: G-F10-COVARIANCE-METROLOGY is PASS only at the declared matched-family, module-byte scope. D-061 is a prospective one-change supersession of preserved D-060: the P-fixed N7X rows are analytically degenerate noise/noise observables, while all asymmetric weak, mass-weighted, native, split-graph, interval-containment, mutation, and restoration checks remain gated and pass. The strongest rejection steelman is that B_cov is loose, the deepest interval replay covers one SA-1 node, and no fully collision-independent MPFR implementation exists. The written method-specific gate is nevertheless met because weak/mass-weighted/native hard caps pass separately, the production split operation graph and all declared error terms are represented, off-grid/event equivariance covers remaining nodes, and the absent mass solve is structurally zero. This is not general-state, continuum, absolute-normalization, or cross-platform validation.
assumptions_used: The gate is applied to the prospectively frozen matched family and exact module bytes.
A structurally absent mass solve has zero contribution rather than an omitted nonzero term.
Bitwise per-event equivariance plus measured shadows is admissible for the bounded covariance claim.
unresolved: No full collision-independent MPFR replay, second platform, all-state theorem, or absolute-normalization validation exists.

findings.statement: The D-063 retained raw numerical payload is a bounded scientific PASS as matched-cell supportive evidence: hashes, embedded Rust spectra, endpoint moments, block values, N_eff, coupled-energy residuals, last-node proxy, exact r2/r3 common payload, and all coded predicates independently recompute; the completed-catalogue anchors and tightened-rtol holdout are credible. This PASS explicitly excludes gate admission and lifecycle provenance. Its prior adjudication envelope has impossible timestamps, so that envelope cannot be used as prospective authority even though the raw stdout/report pair remains useful.
assumptions_used: Exact raw stdout/report consistency supports numerical authenticity but does not replace uncertainty coverage or valid adjudication chronology.
reproduction: Recompute the retained endpoint and residual arithmetic from the exact r3 report.
Compare freeze/output commit times, report wall_seconds, and adjudication started_at/completed_at.
unresolved: A fresh honest adjudication can repair chronology but cannot supply absent scientific evidence.

findings.statement: G-F10-INDEPENDENT-FLRW is FAIL under its unchanged full-spectral pass condition. D-063 does not retain checkpoint occupation/logit states sufficient to recompute reductions, its T11 last-node contribution is not an evolved y>24 tail enclosure, and its rtol-only holdout measures no radial/angular/tail representation uncertainty. T8 also remains unresolved: the full [0,24] degree-47 polynomial domain contains the two excluded Rust nodes and retains sup 2.080064e-3 above the local 2e-3 band; the exclusion is transparent and physically low-weight, so this subissue is INCONCLUSIVE rather than a standalone physics failure, but it cannot provide full-domain PASS. The impossible D-062/D-063 adjudication timestamps independently defeat prospective admission. The strongest acceptance steelman preserves D-063 as strong matched-resolution supportive evidence; the decisive fail-closed result is that supportive evidence does not satisfy every unchanged endpoint gate obligation.
assumptions_used: Full-spectral validation requires a mathematical tail enclosure and enough retained state to reproduce checkpoint reductions.
Same-code bitwise repeats show determinism, not spatial or tail convergence.
A result artifact cannot be committed before its declared completion.
reproduction: Inspect the retained checkpoint-row keys and T11 implementation.
Recompute the all-48-node and masked T8 suprema.
unresolved: Prospectively retain checkpoint states, derive an evolved y>24 enclosure, add one predeclared spatial holdout/norm, and issue a chronologically valid adjudication.

The anti-inflation failure is a separate policy verdict and does not mean this particular F-11/QKE/public-work scope statement failed.

reproduction: Compare the audited path set and D-064 authority ceiling with the exact G-F10-SCOPE statement.

findings.statement: Anti-drift/anti-inflation cost verdict is DRIFT, distinct from the passing G-F10-SCOPE boundary. D057..HEAD adds 21469 and deletes 85 text lines across 148 paths (net +21384); D058--D064 alone is net +16222 across 93 paths, duplicates r3/r4 scientific drivers at roughly 99 percent, and stores four report JSON documents verbatim again inside stdout logs. Mandatory added/deleted/net/token/BMR/cost lines are absent from the D-064 closeout surfaces. Real blocker movement and preserved failures are the strongest retention steelman; the decisive policy failure is the lack of deflation/accounting despite repeated greater-than-400-line evidence commits. Cost values: token_use_exact UNAVAILABLE because no reliable stage counter; blocker_movement_ratio 0.75 for hard validation movement without a new production path; cost_effectiveness_verdict DRIFT.
assumptions_used: Git history preserves superseded executable bytes, so raw-failure preservation does not require duplicate current-tree scripts and report-in-stdout copies.
The anti-drift policy applies to audit/run/document surfaces as well as production code.
reproduction: Compare the paired r3/r4 and r2/r3 scripts and search D-064 closeout surfaces for mandatory cost fields.
unresolved: Deflation is a separate owner/main-writer action; this adjudicator does not authorize deletion.
